data.content: Ahead of the match against Manchester United, Fàbregas previewed: "This is a very important match against one of the most influential and prestigious teams in the history of world football. They have many excellent players, and their coach is experienced and has achieved excellent results. We must gradually learn how to compete against the strongest teams, while recognizing that their strength is superior to ours." [...] He also stated: "We are Como, we were promoted from Serie B to Serie A, and now we are also playing in the Champions League, and we have to play three times a week. Some players have never dealt with such a situation, and neither have I nor my coaching staff. The challenge of the Champions League is that when you play at the Parc des Princes or the Bernabéu, for young players, this experience can drain a lot of their energy emotionally and psychologically. Eighty-five percent of the squad has [...] of the squad has never played in the Champions League. We also need to adapt to playing on one of the world's biggest stages on a Wednesday night, facing such intense competition, and then just three days later, having to travel again.
